equipment.supply.enable.zh-CN: 使用米饭扫荡，自动补足制作所需的木头和金币
equipment.supply.enable.zh-TW: 使用白飯掃蕩，自動補足製作所需的木頭與金幣
equipment.supply.enable.en-US: Use rice sweeps to replenish wood and gold for crafting

equipment.supply.hint.zh-CN: 优先使用现有库存，按制作上限和预算计算最少米饭。木头扫荡使用第九章，金币使用哥布林；需已解锁相应扫荡。
equipment.supply.hint.zh-TW: 優先使用現有庫存，依製作上限與預算計算最少白飯。木頭掃蕩使用第九章，金幣使用哥布林；須已解鎖相應掃蕩。
equipment.supply.hint.en-US: Uses existing stock first, then minimizes rice for your crafting limit and budgets. Wood: Chapter 9; gold: Goblins. The respective sweep must be unlocked.

equipment.supply.total.zh-CN: 米饭合计 {0:N0}（免费 {1:N0}＋储备 {2:N0}）；至少保留米饭 {3:N0}、木头 {4:N0}。
equipment.supply.total.zh-TW: 白飯合計 {0:N0}（免費 {1:N0}＋儲備 {2:N0}）；至少保留白飯 {3:N0}、木頭 {4:N0}。
equipment.supply.total.en-US: Total rice: {0:N0} ({1:N0} free + {2:N0} stored). Keep at least {3:N0} rice and {4:N0} wood.

equipment.supply.estimate.zh-TW: 依目前掃蕩難度與當日加成計算固定收益；不會超出本次確認的白飯量，不購買白飯。
equipment.supply.estimate.en-US: Uses fixed rewards for the selected difficulty and daily bonus. Never exceeds the confirmed rice amount or purchases rice.
equipment.supply.estimate.zh-CN: 按当前扫荡难度与当天加成计算固定收益；不会超出本次确认的米饭量，不购买米饭。

equipment.supply.balance.zh-CN: 免费米饭 {0:N0} · 储备米饭 {1:N0} · 木头 {2:N0}
equipment.supply.balance.zh-TW: 免費白飯 {0:N0} · 儲備白飯 {1:N0} · 木頭 {2:N0}

equipment.supply.shortfall.zh-CN: 实际资源可制作 {0:N0} / {1:N0} 件；已保留米饭和木头，不会额外扫荡。
equipment.supply.shortfall.zh-TW: 實際資源可製作 {0:N0} / {1:N0} 件；已保留白飯與木頭，不會額外掃蕩。
equipment.supply.shortfall.en-US: Actual resources allowed {0:N0} / {1:N0} crafts. Rice and wood reserves were kept; no extra sweeps were started.

equipment.supply.riceUnavailable.en-US: Rice is unavailable. Refresh inventory, or turn off rice replenishment to craft from existing stock.
equipment.supply.riceUnavailable.zh-TW: 無法讀取白飯數量，請重新讀取庫存；關閉白飯補給後仍可依現有庫存製作。
equipment.supply.riceUnavailable.zh-CN: 未能读取米饭数量，请重新读取库存；关闭米饭补给后仍可按现有库存制作。

equipment.supply.quoteError.en-US: Sweep rewards could not be read. Refresh inventory and calculate again. Details have been retained.
equipment.supply.quoteError.zh-TW: 無法讀取掃蕩收益，請重新讀取庫存後計算；詳情已保留。
equipment.supply.quoteError.zh-CN: 未能读取扫荡收益，请重新读取库存后计算；详情已保留。

equipment.supply.routeUnavailable.en-US: This sweep is unavailable. Check that it is unlocked in game, or calculate a new plan.
equipment.supply.routeUnavailable.zh-TW: 該掃蕩暫不可用。請在遊戲中確認已解鎖，或重新計算可用方案。
equipment.supply.routeUnavailable.zh-CN: 该扫荡暂不可用。请在游戏中确认已解锁，或重新计算可用方案。

equipment.supply.routeChanged.en-US: Sweep difficulty or rice cost changed. Refresh inventory and calculate again.
equipment.supply.routeChanged.zh-TW: 掃蕩難度或白飯費用已變更，請重新讀取庫存並計算。
equipment.supply.routeChanged.zh-CN: 扫荡难度或米饭费用已变化，请重新读取库存并计算。

equipment.supply.reserveChanged.en-US: This batch would cross the rice reserve. Refresh inventory and calculate again.
equipment.supply.reserveChanged.zh-TW: 目前白飯不足以完成本批並保留預留量，請重新讀取庫存並計算。
equipment.supply.reserveChanged.zh-CN: 当前米饭不足以完成本批并保留预留量，请重新读取库存并计算。

equipment.supply.inventoryChanged.en-US: Inventory changed while reading sweep information. Refresh inventory and calculate again.
equipment.supply.inventoryChanged.zh-TW: 讀取掃蕩資訊期間庫存有變更，請重新讀取庫存並計算。
equipment.supply.inventoryChanged.zh-CN: 读取扫荡信息期间库存有变化，请重新读取库存并计算。

equipment.supply.resolveConfirm.en-US: The last sweep could not be fully confirmed. Keep its records, discard the remaining old plan, and replan from the inventory just read. The old sweep will not be resent; a new plan still requires confirmation.
equipment.supply.resolveConfirm.zh-TW: 上次掃蕩無法確認完整結果。將保留原記錄，放棄舊計畫剩餘部分，依剛讀取的庫存重新規劃。不會重送舊掃蕩；新計畫仍須確認後才執行。
equipment.supply.resolveConfirm.zh-CN: 上次扫荡未能确认完整结果。将保留原记录，放弃旧计划的剩余部分，以刚读取的库存重新规划。不会重发旧扫荡；新计划仍需确认后才执行。

equipment.supply.resolved.en-US: The old plan was kept as a record. Calculate and confirm a new plan from current inventory.
equipment.supply.resolved.zh-TW: 舊計畫已保留為記錄。請依目前庫存重新計算並確認。
equipment.supply.resolved.zh-CN: 旧计划已保留为记录。请按当前库存重新计算并确认。

equipment.supply.pending.en-US: The last sweep is unconfirmed. Refresh inventory to recheck, or start over from current inventory.
equipment.supply.pending.zh-TW: 上次掃蕩結果尚未確認。可再次讀取庫存確認，或依目前庫存重新開始。
equipment.supply.pending.zh-CN: 上次扫荡结果尚未确认。可再次读取库存核对，或按当前库存重新开始。

equipment.supply.unavailableSummary.en-US: {0} is unavailable; this plan uses the other available resources.
equipment.supply.unavailableSummary.zh-TW: {0} 暫不可用，本次僅依其他可用資源計算。
equipment.supply.unavailableSummary.zh-CN: {0} 暂不可用，本次仅按其他可用资源计算。

equipment.ui.detail.en-US: Full details of the highlighted item
